name: forge
description: A personal deckbuilding workbench for Riftbound

scripts.build: npm run build -w @forge/engine && npm run build -w @forge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @forge/engine && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run check:docs && npm run check:purity && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
